title: Neighbors
tagline: The frat's next door. So are the snacks.
about: A young couple with a baby go to war with the fraternity that moves in next door.
cue: Serve the snacks when the frat throws its first party.

    StartersFrat party pork and fennel sausage rollsPork, apple and fennel sausage rolls in puff pastryHow to make it500g pork sausage mince1 apple, grated1 onion, grated2 tsp fennel seeds, crushed30g breadcrumbs2 sheets of puff pastry1 egg, beaten1 tbsp sesame seeds200g tomato relish1/2 tsp smoked paprikaMix the sausage mince with the apple, onion, fennel, breadcrumbs and pepper.Cut the pastry in half. Lay a log of filling along each strip, roll up and seal underneath.Brush with egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and cut each roll into pieces.Bake at 200°C until golden.Stir the paprika into the relish and serve alongside.Baby Stella date night baked brieBaked brie with honey thyme walnuts, baguette toasts and grapesHow to make it200g brie wheel50g walnuts2 tbsp honey1 small bunch thyme1 baguette, sliced thinly2 tbsp olive oil300g grapesScore the top of the brie in a criss-cross and sit it in a small ovenproof dish.Brush the baguette slices with oil and bake at 180°C alongside the brie until crisp. Remove the toasts first.Toast the walnuts in a dry pan, then warm with the honey and thyme leaves.Spoon the nuts over the hot brie and serve with the toasts and grapes.Bacon mac and cheese bitesFuel for the airbag prank on Mac.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsBackyard barbecue steak with chimichurriGrilled rump with parsley chimichurri, corn, sausages and apple slawHow to make it1 bunch parsley2 garlic cloves1 tsp dried oregano1/2 tsp chilli flakes3 tbsp red wine vinegar100ml olive oil4 corn cobs8 pork sausages800g rump steak1/4 cabbage, shredded1 apple, julienned3 tbsp mayonnaise1 lemonBlitz the parsley, garlic, oregano, chilli, vinegar and oil into chimichurri.Grill the corn, turning.Grill the sausages.Season the steak and grill over high heat, then rest and slice.Toss the cabbage and apple with the mayonnaise and lemon juice.Spoon the chimichurri over the steak and serve with corn, sausages and slaw.Robert De Niro party chicken parm heroesDelta Psi's De Niro night, everyone in a mole and a sneerHow to make it2 large chicken breasts, halved and flattened60g plain flour2 eggs120g panko breadcrumbs150ml vegetable oil300ml napoli sauce200g mozzarella, sliced4 hero rolls100g rocket20g parmesan, gratedHeat the oven to 200°C. Dust the chicken in flour, dip in beaten egg and coat in panko.Fry until golden and cooked through.Lay in the split rolls, spoon over the napoli, top with mozzarella and bake until melted.Serve with rocket and parmesan.SweetsTeddy and Pete's sprinkle sheet cakeVanilla sprinkle cake with cream cheese frostingHow to make it280g butter, soft250g caster sugar3 eggs2 tsp vanilla extract300g self-raising flour200ml full cream milk100g rainbow sprinkles250g cream cheese300g icing sugarBeat most of the butter with the sugar until pale. Beat in the eggs and vanilla, then fold in the flour and milk.Fold through some of the sprinkles and spread into a lined 23 x 33cm tin.Bake at 180°C and cool completely.Beat the cream cheese with the remaining butter and icing sugar until fluffy.Spread over the cake and finish with more sprinkles.DrinksDelta Psi tropical rum punchWhite rum, pineapple juice, passionfruit and lime in a big bowlHow to make it1 L pineapple juice4 passionfruits2 limes, juiced200ml white rum1 L cold lemonade2 oranges, sliced1 small bunch mint1 bag iceMix the pineapple juice, passionfruit pulp, lime juice and rum in a big jug or bowl.Chill.Just before serving, add the lemonade, orange slices and plenty of ice.
